newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Saurer posts higher Q1 sales, orders.
newsitem.headline: Saurer posts higher Q1 sales, orders.

text.p: Swiss textile machinery and automobile component maker Saurer AG said its sales for the 1997 first quarter rose by one percent to 387 million Swiss francs and order inflow was up 62 percent to 502 million francs.
Saurer reported sales for the 1996 first quarter of 384 million francs and its orders for the same period were 310 million.
Saurer chief financial officer Heinrich Fischer said at a news conference the sales rise was due to favourable exchange rate comparisons.
Without this factor, sales would have been some 10 percent below the 1996 first quarter level, he said.
